name: warehouse-simulator
description: Warehouse Simulator - 倉庫管理 + 2Dレイアウト作成 + 物流シミュレーション

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm -w @ws/shared run dev" "npm -w @ws/server run dev" "npm -w @ws/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @ws/server run build && npm -w @ws/web run build
scripts.test: npm -w @ws/shared run test && npm -w @ws/server run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @ws/shared run typecheck && npm -w @ws/server run typecheck && npm -w @ws/web run typecheck
